title: Delete my account
help: Permanently remove your account, owned workspace, uploaded files, conversations, memory and derived data. This cannot be undone.
scope: {count, plural, one {# owned workspace will be erased.} other {# owned workspaces will be erased.}}
workspace_has_members: Remove the other members from your owned workspace before deleting your account.
workspace_has_live_invitations: Revoke outstanding invitations to your owned workspace before deleting your account.
operator: This is the instance administrator. Deletion locks administrator setup. Restoring administration requires access to the host.
limits: Host backups, deployment secrets and copies retained by external providers require separate handling by the operator or provider.
failed: Deletion could not be accepted. Retry the requirements check before trying again.
tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
phase.label: Current step: {phase}
phase.auxiliary: Clearing temporary data and agent checkpoints
failure.label: Cleanup issue: {category}
failure.remote: External connector cleanup needs a retry
failure.shared: Shared processing cleanup needs a retry
failure.unknown: Cleanup needs a retry or host operator assistance
status.title: Account deletion status
status.help: This browser can check progress using a restricted receipt. No account data is displayed here.
queued: Deletion accepted. Your account is locked and cleanup is queued.
running: Cleanup is running. Your account remains locked.
cleanupFailed: Cleanup needs attention. The account stays locked and the worker will retry. Contact the host operator if this persists.
succeeded: App-controlled account data has been erased.
progress: Keep this browser to check progress. The receipt remains available for seven days after completion.
noReceipt: No valid deletion receipt is available in this browser. Ask the host operator to inspect the deletion operation; signing in cannot restore a deleted account.
status.unavailable: Deletion progress is temporarily unavailable. This does not mean cleanup has completed.
